short_description: A regional carrier's NOC drowns in a 457-alarm storm from 64 cell sites. A Lakeflow SDP pipeline streams RAN KPIs, alarms and optical counters into Unity Catalog; topology correlation turns the storm into one incident and a KPI anomaly model (Isolation Forest in UC) finds a sector degrading with no alarm. The NOC Copilot app on Lakebase runs a triage agent that walks the topology to the root cause (a fiber cut plus a backup optic nobody fixed), sizes customer impact, asks the Genie agent about the NOC runbooks, and opens one parent trouble ticket with the right field dispatch; ops leadership tracks availability, alarms and MTTR in an AI/BI dashboard and Genie.
